jobs.title: Senior Vice President IT - Generation, Transmission & Distribution
jobs.description:
Job Posting End Date

10-19-2026

Please note the job posting will close on the day before the posting end date.

Job Summary

We are seeking a dynamic and visionary Senior Vice President of IT - Generation, Transmission & Distribution to lead the strategy, development, implementation, operations, and support of technology solutions that power the company's core utility operations and asset-intensive businesses. This executive will provide enterprise leadership for information technology platforms supporting Generation, Transmission, and Distribution and related operational functions. The role will also oversee technology readiness activities associated with mergers, acquisitions, divestitures, and major business transformation initiatives.

The SVP is accountable for the strategy, delivery, operations, and business outcomes of the technology portfolio supporting Generation, Transmission, and Distribution. This leader will drive digital transformation, operational excellence, reliability, safety, and workforce productivity while serving as a strategic partner to business executives across the enterprise.

Job Description

What You'll Do:

Strategic Leadership & Vision

Develop and execute a comprehensive technology strategy supporting Generation, Transmission, Distribution, and related business functions.
Establish an enterprise-wide digital roadmap that advances operational excellence, business performance, grid modernization, generation optimization, and long-term enterprise objectives.
Align technology investments with strategic priorities, regulatory requirements, cybersecurity standards, and measurable business outcomes.
Lead modernization initiatives that enhance safety, reliability, resiliency, asset performance, operational efficiency, and workforce productivity.
Identify and assess emerging technologies that create competitive advantages and support the evolution of a more intelligent, connected, and sustainable utility.

Technology Leadership & Expertise

Provide executive oversight of technology platforms supporting:

Generation Operations and Asset Performance
Transmission and Distribution Operations
GIS and Network Modeling
Engineering and Design Systems
Construction and Capital Project Management
Grid Planning and Analytics
Field Mobility and Workforce Solutions
Outage Planning and Management Integration
Generation SCADA and Market Operations
Fuels Management and Settlements
Environmental and Compliance Management
Vegetation and Infrastructure Management
Production Accounting and Performance Management
Telecommunications and Field Communications Technologies

Additional responsibilities include:

Drive modernization through Artificial Intelligence (AI), cloud technologies, scalable architectures, enterprise integration platforms, and modern application ecosystems.
Champion Agile delivery, DevSecOps, API-first architecture, automation, and modern software engineering practices that improve speed, quality, security, reliability, and reuse across the technology organization.
Lead enterprise adoption of AI, machine learning, digital twins, predictive analytics, intelligent automation, and optimization technologies to improve safety, reliability, affordability, and customer outcomes.
Ensure technology platforms operate as an integrated ecosystem supporting seamless data and process flow across the asset lifecycle.

Business Partnership

Serve as the primary technology partner for Generation, Transmission, and Distribution leadership.
Translate business priorities and operational challenges into measurable technology outcomes.
Support end-to-end utility asset lifecycle management from planning and design through construction, operations, maintenance, optimization, and retirement.\
Lead technology investment planning, portfolio prioritization, business case development, and value realization efforts.
Establish and maintain strategic vendor and partner relationships that advance business and technology objectives.
Serve as the accountable Service Owner for technology platforms supporting Generation, Transmission, and Distribution, with responsibility for performance, risk, and business outcomes.

Governance, Risk & Compliance

Ensure compliance with cybersecurity standards, regulatory mandates, environmental requirements, reliability standards, and enterprise governance policies.
Establish governance processes and decision frameworks for technology portfolios, investments, architecture, and delivery performance.
Own technology financial performance, budget management, investment prioritization, and return-on-investment accountability.
Advance enterprise data governance, data quality, and information management capabilities.
Partner closely with cybersecurity and operational technology leaders to maintain secure, resilient, and compliant technology environments.

Talent & Culture Development

Build, lead, and develop a high-performing technology organization supporting utility operational excellence.
Create leadership pipelines, succession plans, and talent development programs that strengthen organizational capability.
Foster a culture of innovation, accountability, collaboration, continuous improvement, and customer focus.
Develop leaders capable of thinking beyond functional silos to drive enterprise-wide impact.
Promote inclusion, learning, and engagement while attracting and retaining top technology talent.

Thought Leadership & Enterprise Impact

Serve as a trusted advisor to executive leadership on technology trends, digital transformation opportunities, and business innovation.
Represent the company in industry forums, regulatory discussions, technology councils, and strategic partnerships.
Lead enterprise conversations around AI, operational intelligence, advanced analytics, and emerging utility technologies.
Drive technology strategies that improve reliability, resilience, affordability, safety, sustainability, and customer satisfaction.
Support enterprise transformation initiatives, including mergers, acquisitions, integrations, and major organizational change programs.

What We're Looking For:

Education:

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or related discipline required.
Master's degree in Business Administration, Engineering, Information Technology, or related field preferred.

Experience:

15+ years of progressive technology leadership experience within utility operations, energy, engineering, infrastructure, manufacturing, or other asset-intensive industries.

Other Must Haves:

Demonstrated success leading large-scale technology organizations and enterprise digital transformation initiatives.
Deep expertise in operational technologies, asset management, utility operations, engineering systems, enterprise applications, data analytics, and technology modernization.
Strong business acumen with the ability to connect technology strategy to operational and financial outcomes.
Proven ability to lead complex portfolios, large budgets, strategic investments, and executive stakeholder relationships.
Exceptional communication, organizational leadership, and change management skills.
Deep knowledge of electric utility operations, including Generation, Transmission, Distribution, and asset lifecycle management.
Experience with grid modernization, renewable energy technologies, market operations, and emerging energy technologies.
Expertise in enterprise asset management, GIS, engineering systems, predictive maintenance, digital twins, advanced analytics, and AI-enabled solutions.
Proven track record driving enterprise-wide organizational transformation and technology adoption.
Experience leading technology integration activities associated with mergers, acquisitions, and business transformation efforts.

Where You'll Work:

On-Site in the AEP Headquarters in Columbus, OH

What You'll Get:

Base salary
Annual bonus
Long-term incentive
401K match
AEP Pension
Comprehensive benefits package that aims to support and enhance the overall well-being of our employees.

Where Putting the Customer First Powers Everything We Do!

At AEP, we’re more than just an energy company — we’re a team of dedicated professionals committed to delivering safe, reliable, and innovative energy solutions. Guided by our mission to put the customer first, we strive to exceed expectations by listening, responding, and continuously improving the way we serve our communities. If you're passionate about making a meaningful impact and being part of a forward-thinking organization, this is the company for you!

jobs.title: Director, Technology Risk and Business Continuity
jobs.description:
Oversee IT, Information Security, and Business Continuity/Disaster Recovery (BCP/DR) risks across the credit union. Partner with technology and business leaders within the three lines of defense framework to provide independent oversight and advisory support, ensuring technology risks are effectively managed and aligned with the organization's risk appetite, regulatory expectations, and strategic objectives. Serve as the primary liaison between Enterprise Risk Management and technology leadership to promote transparency, resilience, and informed risk-based decision-making.

- This position is hybrid.

- NYC Salary Range: $150,000 - $200,000 annually: compensation is commensurate to geographic location.

ACCOUNTABILITIES:

Technology and Emerging Risk Oversight

* Regardless of seniority or role, uphold UNFCU’s mission, core values, and guiding principles by providing an exceptional service experience to colleagues and members alike through consistent demonstration of our service excellence behaviors.
* Provide independent second-line oversight of Information Technology, Information Security/Cyber, AI, technology resilience, and infrastructure risks, ensuring effective governance across the organization.
* Assess and challenge first-line risk assessments, control effectiveness, and mitigation strategies related to core systems, cloud adoption, data management, AI, automation, and third-party technology risks.

AI Risk and Governance

* Provide independent oversight of AI governance, including AI use cases, model lifecycle controls, decision-support frameworks, and risks such as bias, explainability, data integrity, and misuse.
* Partner with technology and business leaders to ensure AI initiatives align with regulatory requirements, governance standards, ethical principles, and effective management of financial, operational, and reputational risks.

Information Security Risk Governance

* Partner with Information Security leadership to provide independent oversight of cyber risk management, including security incidents, identity and access management, data protection, threat and vulnerability management, and alignment with regulatory and industry standards.

Business Continuity & Disaster Recovery Oversight

* Provide independent oversight of the organization's Business Continuity and Disaster Recovery (BCP/DR) frameworks, including scenario design, testing effectiveness, recovery objectives (RTO/RPO), and operational resilience.
* Partner with first-line technology leadership to review and challenge BCP/DR strategies, testing results, remediation efforts, and readiness for technology failures, third-party disruptions, and other resilience scenarios.

Risk Identification, Monitoring, and Reporting

* Develop and maintain the technology and operational resilience risk framework, including key risk indicators (KRIs), thresholds, and enterprise-wide risk integration.
* Monitor and escalate material IT, cyber, and resilience risks to executive leadership and the Risk Management Committee through effective reporting and governance.

Governance and Cross-Functional Coordination

* Serve as the primary Enterprise Risk Management liaison to IT leadership, business lines, and operational teams, fostering effective collaboration and risk governance.
* Provide independent second-line oversight by challenging first-line risk ownership and supporting key governance forums, including technology, product, and incident management committees.

Issue Management and Continuous Improvement

* Partner with first-line stakeholders to identify technology-related issues, validate root causes and remediation plans, and monitor corrective actions through resolution.
* Support the Issue Management Program by ensuring technology risks are documented, tracked, and resolved in compliance with regulatory requirements and the organization's Code of Ethics and Business Conduct.

* Bachelor's degree in Risk Management, Information Systems, or related field
* 10+ years of experience in a financial services environment with exposure to regulated environments, including a minimum of 4 or more years in a second line or commensurate risk function
* Experience in technology, cyber, and operational resilience risk management, including regulatory compliance, risk identification, monitoring, issue management, risk reporting, and cross-functional collaboration with business partners.
* Demonstrated ability to provide independent challenge to senior stakeholders, translate technical risks into business and financial impacts
* Strong knowledge of enterprise risk management, financial services regulations (e.g., NCUA, FFIEC, OCC), the three lines of defense model, and technology, cyber, and emerging AI risk frameworks (e.g., NIST, ISO, COBIT).
* Proficient in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, with sound risk judgment, analytical skills, and the ability to provide independent, objective oversight.
* Strategic thinker with strong digital, cyber, and AI risk awareness, capable of balancing governance, partnership, and practical business solutions.
* Exceptional executive communication and influencing skills, with the ability to build relationships and drive outcomes without direct authority, including presenting to senior leadership and the Board.

jobs.title: Vice President of Technology
jobs.description:
Company Description
NN Investment Partners-o is a global investment management organization focused on delivering long-term value for clients through disciplined, research-driven strategies. The company combines financial expertise with advanced technology to develop innovative investment solutions and robust risk management practices. NN Investment Partners-o fosters a collaborative culture that encourages continuous improvement, ethical decision-making, and transparency. Team members work in a dynamic environment where data, technology, and market insight are leveraged to support informed investment decisions and excellent client service.
Role Description
The Vice President of Technology is a full-time, remote leadership role responsible for defining and executing the technology vision that supports NN Investment Partners-o’s business and investment strategies. This role oversees the design, implementation, and maintenance of technology platforms, systems, and infrastructure, ensuring reliability, security, and scalability. Day-to-day responsibilities include leading cross-functional IT teams, prioritizing and managing technology projects, and aligning IT initiatives with organizational goals and regulatory requirements. The Vice President of Technology collaborates closely with senior leadership to develop IT roadmaps, optimize processes, and evaluate emerging technologies that can drive operational efficiencies and competitive advantage. This role also ensures strong vendor management, risk mitigation, and adherence to best practices in data governance and cybersecurity.
Qualifications

Candidates should possess strong Analytical Skills to interpret complex data, evaluate technology performance, and support evidence-based decision-making.
Candidates should possess deep expertise in Information Technology, including enterprise systems, infrastructure, security, and cloud-based solutions.
Candidates should possess experience in IT Strategy to align technology investments with business objectives and long-term organizational priorities.
Candidates should possess proven Project Management skills to lead initiatives, manage timelines and budgets, and coordinate cross-functional teams.
Candidates should possess Strategic Planning capabilities to develop technology roadmaps, anticipate future needs, and drive innovation.
Extensive leadership experience in technology or IT management, ideally within financial services or a similarly regulated industry.
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with executive leaders and diverse teams.
Experience with governance, risk management, and compliance frameworks relevant to technology and data in investment or financial environments.
Proficiency in modern architectures and tools (e.g., cloud platforms, APIs, data integration, cybersecurity practices) is highly beneficial.
Advanced degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

jobs.title: Sr. IT Project Manager
jobs.description:
Position Description

Harris County Universal Services (Universal Services) is transforming the way the County does business and seeking an experienced and strategic Senior IT Project Manager to join our team.

Universal Services is the enterprise IT solutions center for the departments and offices of Harris County, providing Information Technology, Public Safety and Justice Technologies, 311 Constituent Engagement Services, Fleet Services, and Records and Information Governance Services.

Harris County is the third largest and most diverse county in the nation, with a population of more than 4.7 million. Harris County Commissioners Court, the County’s governing body, directs a budget of more than $4 billion providing essential services including flood control, infrastructure, healthcare, housing, and justice administration.

Job Overview

This Universal Services position reports into the Enterprise Project Management Office (EPMO). The primary purpose of the Senior IT Project Manager role is to lead, oversee and ensure the successful delivery and management of enterprise technology projects. The Senior IT Project Manager must deliver projects within scope, on time and within budget. The Senior IT Project Manager is responsible for the creation, organization, execution, and completion of assigned projects, in accordance with the EPMO standards and methodology. This includes managing the project team, establishing milestones and target dates, communicating with and preparing reports to stakeholders about the project, and adjusting as necessary to meet new requirements and scope changes.

Primary Responsibilities and Activities:

Review project proposals or plans to determine a time frame, funding limitations, procedures for accomplishing projects, staffing requirements and the assignment of available departmental resources to various project phases.
Identify and schedule project deliverables, milestones, and required activities and tasks.
Provide leadership and motivation to project team members throughout the project lifecycle and confer with project staff to outline a work plan.
Act as a coach to junior project managers, executives and others who need assistance and advice regarding project management practices.
Establish a work plan and staffing for project activities, iterations or phases, and arrange for recruitment or assignment of project personnel.
Analyze project proposals to determine a time frame, funding limitations and appropriate processes for accomplishing projects.
Review/approve the work plan of an external service provider or consultancy contracted to execute the project.
Implement a project communication plan.
Conduct risk assessment and mitigation.
Monitor project activities, ensuring the currency, quality and integrity of information, while providing consistency in content and “look and feel” across the organization.
Ensure that project goals are in line with business objectives.
Ensure that project goals are achieved.
Assign duties and responsibilities to project personnel and define the scope of their authority.
Direct and coordinate the activities of project personnel to ensure projects progress on schedule and within budget.
Review status reports prepared by project personnel and modify schedules or plans as required.
Establish standards and procedures for project reporting and documentation.
Benchmark project management performance continuously to identify the potential for improvements and increase capability in project and portfolio management.
Manage the Relationship with the Client and all Stakeholders
Analyze PMO policies regarding Customer Service and Efficiency recommending policy changes and process improvements as needed.
Work onsite as needed.

Primary Contacts:

Project sponsor and key stakeholders
Project team/staff (including designated users or customers)
Business unit management and executives
Subject matter experts such as:
Enterprise architects
IT Infrastructure and Operations
Cybersecurity
Data and Analytics
Business and functional analysts
User/customer product owner
External service providers and consultants and their project man

Harris County is an Equal Opportunity Employer

https://hrrm.harriscountytx.gov/Pages/EqualEmploymentOpportunityPlan.aspx

If you need special services or accommodations, please call (713) 274-5445 or email ADACoordinator@bmd.hctx.net .

This position is subject to a criminal history check. Only relevant convictions will be considered and, even when considered, may not automatically disqualify the candidate.

Requirements

Education:

Bachelor’s degree in business information systems, computer science, business administration, or a related field.

Experience:

Seven or more years of progressively responsible IT experience, with sensitivity and commitment to business problem solving
Five years of successfully managing complex projects
Five or more years of Business Unit or Business Unit-facing experience, with sensitivity and commitment to business problem solving
Experience in leading diverse teams
Experience and ability in using soft skills and people skills

Knowledge and Skills:

Distinctive blend of business, IT, financial and communication skills. This blend is vital because this is a highly visible position with substantial impact.
Ability to adapt to new circumstances in a changing business environment.
Good understanding of current and emerging technologies, and of how other enterprises are using them to drive digital business solutions.
Knowledge of project management methodology and experience or familiarity with major, defined program management approaches.
Significant knowledge of project planning/scheduling tools (for example, Microsoft Project, Planview PPM Pro, ServiceNow Strategic Portfolio Management, or Open Workbench), with a solid track record of practical application.
Exceptional verbal and written communication skills; expertise in setting and managing customer expectations.
Effective influencing and negotiating skills in an environment in which this role may not directly control resources.
Strong knowledge and understanding of business needs, with the ability to establish and maintain a high level of customer trust and confidence.
Ability to support a tactical resource plan by mapping future demand to forecast project completions in the project portfolio.

Applicants for this position will be subject to a criminal background check that includes being fingerprinted. This applies to any position with network access to Criminal Justice Information Services (CJIS) or access to an area where CJIS is received, maintained or stored either manually or electronically (i.e. custodian, maintenance).

Automatic Disqualification:

Convictions, probation, or deferred adjudication for any Felony, and any Class A Misdemeanor
Convictions, probation, or deferred adjudication for a Class B Misdemeanor, if within the previous 10 years
Open arrest for any criminal offense (Felony or Misdemeanor)
Family Violence conviction

NOTE:
Qualifying education, experience, knowledge and skills must be documented on your job application. You may attach a resume to the application as supporting documentation but ONLY information stated on the application will be used for consideration. "See Resume"
will not be accepted for qualifications.

Preferences

Certifications

PMP Certification from the Project Management Institute or equivalent certification is desirable

General Information

Location:

1111 Fannin St., Houston, Tx 77002

Work Schedule:

8 hours/Day

Work Arrangement:

Hybrid (combination of working onsite and working from home)

Employment may be contingent on passing a drug screen and meeting other standards.

Due to a high volume of applications positions may close prior to the advertised closing date or at the discretion of the Hiring Department.

new_jobs.description:
Position Description

Harris County Universal Services (Universal Services) is transforming the way the County does business and seeking an experienced and strategic Senior IT Project Manager to join our team.

Universal Services is the enterprise IT solutions center for the departments and offices of Harris County, providing Information Technology, Public Safety and Justice Technologies, 311 Constituent Engagement Services, Fleet Services, and Records and Information Governance Services.

Harris County is the third largest and most diverse county in the nation, with a population of more than 4.7 million. Harris County Commissioners Court, the County’s governing body, directs a budget of more than $4 billion providing essential services including flood control, infrastructure, healthcare, housing, and justice administration.

Job Overview

This Universal Services position reports into the Enterprise Project Management Office (EPMO). The primary purpose of the Senior IT Project Manager role is to lead, oversee and ensure the successful delivery and management of enterprise technology projects. The Senior IT Project Manager must deliver projects within scope, on time and within budget. The Senior IT Project Manager is responsible for the creation, organization, execution, and completion of assigned projects, in accordance with the EPMO standards and methodology. This includes managing the project team, establishing milestones and target dates, communicating with and preparing reports to stakeholders about the project, and adjusting as necessary to meet new requirements and scope changes.

Primary Responsibilities and Activities:

Review project proposals or plans to determine a time frame, funding limitations, procedures for accomplishing projects, staffing requirements and the assignment of available departmental resources to various project phases.
Identify and schedule project deliverables, milestones, and required activities and tasks.
Provide leadership and motivation to project team members throughout the project lifecycle and confer with project staff to outline a work plan.
Act as a coach to junior project managers, executives and others who need assistance and advice regarding project management practices.
Establish a work plan and staffing for project activities, iterations or phases, and arrange for recruitment or assignment of project personnel.
Analyze project proposals to determine a time frame, funding limitations and appropriate processes for accomplishing projects.
Review/approve the work plan of an external service provider or consultancy contracted to execute the project.
Implement a project communication plan.
Conduct risk assessment and mitigation.
Monitor project activities, ensuring the currency, quality and integrity of information, while providing consistency in content and “look and feel” across the organization.
Ensure that project goals are in line with business objectives.
Ensure that project goals are achieved.
Assign duties and responsibilities to project personnel and define the scope of their authority.
Direct and coordinate the activities of project personnel to ensure projects progress on schedule and within budget.
Review status reports prepared by project personnel and modify schedules or plans as required.
Establish standards and procedures for project reporting and documentation.
Benchmark project management performance continuously to identify the potential for improvements and increase capability in project and portfolio management.
Manage the Relationship with the Client and all Stakeholders
Analyze PMO policies regarding Customer Service and Efficiency recommending policy changes and process improvements as needed.
Work onsite as needed.

Primary Contacts:

Project sponsor and key stakeholders
Project team/staff (including designated users or customers)
Business unit management and executives
Subject matter experts such as:
Enterprise architects
IT Infrastructure and Operations
Cybersecurity
Data and Analytics
Business and functional analysts
User/customer product owner
External service providers and consultants and their project man

Ability to adapt to new circumstances in a changing business environment.
Good understanding of current and emerging technologies, and of how other enterprises are using them to drive digital business solutions.
